MainBanner.title: Strategic System on Desertification and Drought
MainBanner.subtitle: SEDES is the instrument that gives operational effect to the legal obligation to establish an integrated information system addressing drought occurrence, vegetation cover loss, land degradation, and desertification. This obligation is assigned to public authorities by Law No. 13,153/2015 under the National Policy to Combat Desertification and Mitigate the Effects of Drought (PNCD).
